summary: Confirmed WooCommerce API outage root cause and documented frontend behavior. Backend is healthy; all product/category API calls fail with 'Store request failed' due to external WooCommerce site returning 404. Non-WooCommerce UI sections work correctly.

critical.issue: Returns 404 from external WooCommerce (sojaru.co.in/wp-json/wc/v3). Backend responds with {"detail": "Store request failed."}. ROOT CAUSE: WordPress permalink settings broken on Hostinger — /wp-json/ itself returns 404. NOT a code bug.

integration_issues.flow: Product sections (your favorites are back, Our Best Sellers, Sheer Joy)
integration_issues.issue: Product cards show skeleton/shimmer loading state permanently — no products displayed. No error shown to user for these sections (infinite loading state, not graceful error). Only 'Durga Pujo Collections' shows the 'Something went sideways / Try again' error UI.

issues: 'your favorites are back', 'Our Best Sellers', 'Sheer Joy' sections show skeleton shimmer cards indefinitely with no error message — user has no feedback that products failed to load. Only 'Durga Pujo Collections' shows the correct error/retry UI. Consider showing error state for all product sections.

verified_working: GET /api/ returns {brand: Sojaru, status: ok} — backend is healthy
Marquee ticker working: 'Free shipping over ₹999', 'Curated for you & your best friend', 'Made in India, with love'
Welcome text: 'We are back! :)' and 'hello! welcome home :)' visible
Category bento grid section absent (no categories loaded — renders null as expected)
Our Story section loads correctly with image and text
action_items: EXTERNAL ISSUE (not code): Fix WordPress permalink settings on Hostinger for sojaru.co.in — go to WP Admin > Settings > Permalinks and re-save to regenerate .htaccess. This will restore /wp-json/ REST API endpoint.

CODE IMPROVEMENT: 'your favorites are back', 'Our Best Sellers', 'Sheer Joy' sections show skeleton shimmer indefinitely when API fails — should show error/retry UI like 'Durga Pujo Collections' does. Implement consistent error state across all product sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Inconsistent error state handling: 'Durga Pujo Collections' ProductSection correctly shows error/retry UI but other product sections ('your favorites are back', 'Our Best Sellers', 'Sheer Joy') show skeleton shimmer indefinitely on API failure. All sections should show error/retry consistently.

success_rate.backend: 33% (1/3 non-WC endpoints work, WC-dependent endpoints fail due to external issue)
success_rate.frontend: 70% (non-product sections work; product sections broken due to external API)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Root cause is external: WordPress /wp-json/ returns 404 on sojaru.co.in (Hostinger hosting, permalink settings). Backend code is correct. Once WooCommerce REST API is fixed on the WordPress side, products/categories will load. After fix, test /api/products, /api/categories, and all homepage product sections. Also check that category bento grid appears once categories API returns data.
rca_of_issue: WordPress REST API disabled/broken on Hostinger. sojaru.co.in/wp-json/ returns 404 HTML page. This breaks all WooCommerce API calls (GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products, /wp-json/wc/v3/categories). Fix: WP Admin > Settings > Permalinks > Save Changes (regenerates .htaccess rewrite rules that enable pretty permalinks and REST API routing).
